title: Context in DCLab Code: a meter, /compact and /clear said, and Fork from any of your messages (parity A4)
request: The owner's goal (restated 2026-10-26: continue non-stop): Claude Code and Codex desktop's capabilities in DCLab Code; parity plan step A4: context.
plan: read the SDK's own context estimate after each turn for the status line
say a compaction and a clear in the conversation
fork a new session from one of the person's messages with the SDK's forkSession
keep R&D's training sets free of the fork's copies

decisions.decision: The meter reads getContextUsage({detail: 'summary'}) after each result, with a 5 s limit
decisions.why: the summary costs no model call; a slow or closed agent keeps the last reading

decisions.decision: A fork cuts the agent's conversation at the last main-chain entry before the message (never a subagent's, never a copied record), following forks back to the session that holds it
decisions.why: the SDK gives a fork new uuids and drops sidechains: a cut at a copied or sidechain uuid fails

decisions.decision: Copied records carry copiedFrom; R&D's store skips them and splits a fork with its root source
decisions.why: the person's labels must be counted once and never land in two splits (a sealed-split leak)

decisions.decision: A session in its own copy is not forked yet
decisions.why: the fork would share the copy unguarded: a removal, merge or commit by either would act under the other

decisions.decision: On /clear the session follows the SDK's new conversation id
decisions.why: a resume or a fork after the clear must use the cleared conversation

change: dclab-code: engine.measureContext and conversation_reset; events.js compaction and clear notes, copied flag; POST /api/sessions/:id/fork with cutOf; bin passes forkSession; web: Fork beside Rewind (Rewind hidden on copies), the context meter. R&D: store/sets/dclab_code.py skips copiedFrom records and splits forks by their root.

findings.defect: a fork's copied records became duplicate training labels, possibly across splits
findings.scenario: the person allowed a step and graded a turn, then forked: the keeper emitted the same permission label for the source and the fork, each split by its own SDK id
findings.cause: copied records were unmarked; the split key was the fork's own SDK id
findings.fix: copiedFrom on every copy; the keeper skips them and splits a fork by its root source

findings.defect: a fork shared the source's worktree copy with no guard
findings.scenario: forking a session in its own copy gave a fork in the same folder; removing the copy from the source deleted it under the fork's running agent
findings.cause: the fork took the source's cwd without its worktree state
findings.fix: sessions in their own copy are refused (409) until a shared-copy design exists
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: fork: a session in its own copy is not forked

findings.defect: the fork point could be a subagent's message
findings.scenario: a background subagent streamed after the turn; forking the next message cut at a sidechain uuid the SDK drops: 409
findings.cause: the last assistant or user record with a uuid was taken
findings.fix: main-chain entries only (no parent_tool_use_id), never copied ones

findings.defect: forking a fork and rewinding a copied message failed
findings.scenario: in a fork, Fork on a copied message cut at the source's uuid, unknown in the forked transcript
findings.cause: copies keep the source's uuids; the SDK renames them
findings.fix: a copied message forks from its source; a fork's first own message cuts at its forkOf point; Rewind hidden on copies
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: context ... a fork of the fork

findings.scenario: after /clear the meter kept the old reading and resume and fork used the cleared transcript
findings.fix: the session follows new_conversation_id, the meter resets, the clear is said
findings.test: tests/units.test.js: /clear is said; live: the id changed and the agent no longer knew the word

findings.defect: the meter's tooltip window differed from its percent
findings.scenario: Xk of Yk used maxTokens while the percent is over rawMaxTokens

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every test passes; each new route and note tested
measurements.result: 86+ tests pass, page tests skipped (no Chromium on this machine)

measurements.name: live fork
measurements.gate: a fork before a message keeps the earlier turns and drops the later ones
measurements.result: Haiku: the fork made before 'beta' answered 'alpha'; meter 3% (25.5k of 1M); $0.006

measurements.name: live /clear
measurements.gate: after /clear the agent starts empty and the session follows the new conversation id
measurements.result: the id changed, the note showed, the agent answered NONE for the remembered word; $0.0015

measurements.name: R&D store test
measurements.gate: a fork's copies make no second label; the fork splits with its source

outcome: DCLab Code shows how full the context is, says when it is compacted or cleared, and forks a session from any of the person's messages, as Claude Code does; a fork's copied history stays out of R&D's training sets twice.
lessons: A copy of a record is a new record unless it says it is a copy: mark copies where they are made.
risks: a fork gets its own per-session cap (the daily cap still holds)
forks of sessions in their own copy are not offered yet
